statement:
The record shows the prior court ruling as lifted yet a binding order still requires the post to remain down.
Post P-88 remains taken down per the binding court order.
judge_text:
WRONG

"The record shows the prior court ruling as lifted yet a binding order still requires the post to remain down" — it asserts the record's status contradicts the in-force order and states the post stays down.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
